citations.quote: Authority is not the watch, the suit, the LinkedIn title. Authority is your inner position. Equal adult.

observation.text: The claim of authority is structured by juxtaposing commonly perceived indicators (watch, suit, LinkedIn title) against the true indicator (inner position) with an imperative conclusion (Equal adult).

citations.quote: Transactional analysis founded by Eric Bern studied how people communicate and how the position you take in a conversation creates the reaction of the other person.

observation.text: Transactional analysis is explained by first attributing its founding to Eric Bern, followed by describing its use in communication analysis.

citations.quote: Internal urgency rooted in his own words...grows for days after you hang up.

observation.text: The speaker contrasts internal and external urgency by explaining how internal urgency's impact extends beyond immediate interactions, while external urgency's influence dissipates quickly.

citations.quote: Here is what almost always misunderstood. Authority is not the watch, the suit, the LinkedIn title. Authority is your inner position. Equal adult.

summary.text: Authority is not the watch, the suit, the LinkedIn title; it is your inner position as an equal adult.

citations.quote: Transactional analysis founded by Eric Bern studied how people communicate and how the position you take in a conversation creates the reaction of the other person.
the moment you communicate from dependent position, you start sounding like a child speaking to adult. And your client, he just has no choice but to take the adult position above you.

summary.text: Transactional analysis founded by Eric Bern aids in understanding how communication positions affect interactions. Communicating from a dependent position aligns you in a child role, prompting the client to assume an adult role above you.

citations.quote: From the moment the balance of power is broken, changing its back is not possible. That's why the beginning of conversation is so important.

summary.text: Once the balance of power in a sales conversation is broken, it cannot be restored. Starting from a dependency leads to client superiority, while starting as an equal sets a professional tone.

knowledge.title: Balance of Power in Sales Conversation

citations.quote: Internal urgency rooted in his own words. And it keeps growing in his head because it's connected to the problem that he need to solve.

summary.text: Internal urgency is more effective than external urgency because it continues to influence the client long after the conversation ends.

citations.quote: Because the front camera splits your brain in half.

constraints.text: The front camera should not be used as it divides attention.

citations.quote: Confidence is strained like a muscle.

goal.text: To build confidence in sales conversations.

citations.quote: You have to film yourself on the back camera, not the front one.

prerequisites.text: Have a back camera to record yourself.

citations.quote: So, you film it, then you watch the video right away.

steps.text: Film yourself on the back camera for approximately one minute.

citations.quote: You don't have to do anything. Your brain will do the work.

steps.text: Review the video and let your brain process the self-feedback.

citations.quote: I'm going to give you two exercises. It's only five minutes a day and it's totally free.
So exercise number one, I call it the camera confidence test. It literally takes two minutes.

summary.text: A camera confidence exercise can help improve sales performance by overcoming self-monitoring behaviors.

citations.quote: If in the moment that you hit the send, your stomach tightens...you just borrowed an adult sentence.

constraints.text: The message should not show desperation or over-eagerness.

citations.quote: I've seen my coaching client bring back leads that went silent for months just using this exact line.

goal.text: To reactivate leads that have gone silent after initial contact.

citations.quote: Hi, name? I know life can get busy. Have you completely given up on the idea of making money with Dubai real estate?

steps.text: Craft a follow-up message that challenges the client to reconsider their decision without sounding desperate.

citations.quote: The trick is this, no one wants to admit that he is completely given up on anything.

summary.text: Using a pattern interrupt can reactivate leads that have gone silent by avoiding typical follow-up messages.
